part3_implementation.rootCauseNamedByTheAuditItself: "it is a PRIVATE person shape, so it is enumerated: the client has no single canonical identity model the way the backend now has PERSON_IDENTITY_SELECT." 103 ad-hoc surface extractions and 75 private typed boundaries are symptoms of ONE absence.
part3_implementation.built: lib/core/identity/person_identity_model.dart - AuraPersonIdentity, the client counterpart to the backend's PERSON_IDENTITY_SELECT. Field for field: userId, displayName, handle, avatarUrl, accountStatus. It adds nothing the projection does not carry and renames nothing - a client shape that disagreed with the projection would simply be the 104th private person model.
part3_implementation.tolerantByDesign: F057's defect was two hand-written readers of one payload disagreeing about where the id lived (me['id'] vs me['user']['id']), so the realtime surface resolved an EMPTY id and host detection said 'not host'. One shared reader accepts the person flat or nested under any envelope Aura actually uses, and accepts the field aliases the API actually emits. It cannot disagree with itself.
part3_implementation.honestFallback: label is name, then @handle, then 'Someone' - never 'Participant' (F054's exact defect) and never 'User'. A payload carrying a face but NO identity resolves to unknown rather than rendering an avatar with nobody behind it.
